text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Mubarak to discuss with King Hussein in Aqaba the coordinate their stands and the issues which Mubarak will discuss with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
- Mubarak to hold a meeting of the political group on the developments in the peace process. He will also hold a widescale meeting tomorrow on the Egyptian-European partnership deal.

- Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid will meet the chairmen of 65 public companies today to discuss increasing Egyptian exports to $11 billion a year. State will also offer foreign investors seven government-owned export firms.
- International Monetary Fund official expects a substantial increase in Egyptian exports soon.
- Egypt insists that Israel stop settlement building.
- Information Minister Safwat el-Sherif says that the Mubarak-Netanyahu meeting on Tuesday aims at breaking the deadlock in the peace process.
- The Supreme Syrian-Egyptian Committee will discuss drafting an agreement to protect investment and joint venture firms and setting up a free zone between the two countries.
